nodes.label: Rule: Ask Before Refactoring
nodes.rationale: Identifying a refactoring opportunity does not mean having permission to implement it; the user keeps control of scope expansion.

nodes.label: Refactoring Evaluation Criteria (readability, duplication, typing, architecture, responsibilities, performance, maintainability)
nodes.norm_label: refactoring evaluation criteria (readability, duplication, typing, architecture, responsibilities, performance, maintainability)
nodes.rationale: Avoid inventing problems or suggesting changes based only on stylistic preference.

nodes.label: Scope Preservation / Never Refactor Without Authorization
nodes.norm_label: scope preservation / never refactor without authorization
nodes.rationale: Silence or generic improvement requests are not authorization; necessary in-scope corrections are allowed.

nodes.label: Rule Compliance: explicit approval, never interpret silence as approval
nodes.norm_label: rule compliance: explicit approval, never interpret silence as approval
nodes.rationale: Do not claim a rule was followed or a test passed without verifying it; report unverifiable checks.

nodes.label: Rule Source Conflicts C1-C5
nodes.rationale: Project rules (CLAUDE.md/projeto.md) prevail over ECC design-quality rules; code is source of truth when projeto.md is outdated.

nodes.label: Operation Rules (preserve architecture, code is truth, no mock as real)
nodes.norm_label: operation rules (preserve architecture, code is truth, no mock as real)

nodes.label: Source of Truth Order (code, AGENTS.md, types, mocks...)
nodes.norm_label: source of truth order (code, agents.md, types, mocks...)

nodes.label: IBM Plex Sans Variable typography + Cascadia Mono
nodes.norm_label: ibm plex sans variable typography + cascadia mono

nodes.label: SEDUC-MT Institutional Identity (tricolor signature, navy dark, light gray light)
nodes.norm_label: seduc-mt institutional identity (tricolor signature, navy dark, light gray light)
nodes.rationale: Identity is inherited, not reinvented; tricolor stripe appears only in banner and sidebar brand.

nodes.label: Shell Layout (240px sidebar, auto-collapse <1100px, no top bar)
nodes.norm_label: shell layout (240px sidebar, auto-collapse <1100px, no top bar)
nodes.rationale: Top bar removed on request 22/10/2026; theme toggle moved to sidebar footer.

nodes.label: DESIGN.md: DataHub SEDUC-MT Design System
nodes.rationale: Single source of visual decisions; every new or altered screen reuses these tokens, no parallel palette.

nodes.label: Visual Exclusions (no decorative gradients, glassmorphism, neon, emoji icons)
nodes.norm_label: visual exclusions (no decorative gradients, glassmorphism, neon, emoji icons)

nodes.label: Approved Decisions 21/10/2026 (redesign overhaul, test infra, IBM Plex Sans, split index.css, 1280x800 window, WebP banner)
nodes.norm_label: approved decisions 21/10/2026 (redesign overhaul, test infra, ibm plex sans, split index.css, 1280x800 window, webp banner)
nodes.rationale: D1 redesign is an explicit authorized exception to projeto.md §14/§17; slogan and banner text kept (D3c rejected).

nodes.label: Space, Radius, Elevation and Motion Tokens
nodes.norm_label: space, radius, elevation and motion tokens

nodes.label: Acceptance Criteria and Test Strategy (axe zero serious, >=12px text, no overflow, Vitest, Playwright)
nodes.norm_label: acceptance criteria and test strategy (axe zero serious, >=12px text, no overflow, vitest, playwright)

nodes.label: Audit Methodology (tsc, build, Playwright captures, axe-core, keyboard, overflow)
nodes.norm_label: audit methodology (tsc, build, playwright captures, axe-core, keyboard, overflow)

nodes.label: Implementation Batches L0-L8
nodes.rationale: Exclusive file ownership per batch so parallel agents never edit the same file.

nodes.label: Shared Components to Create (ui/Button, Field, SectionTitle, OptionCard, FileField, SimulationNotice, StatusText, Checkbox, SelectableChip)
nodes.norm_label: shared components to create (ui/button, field, sectiontitle, optioncard, filefield, simulationnotice, statustext, checkbox, selectablechip)

nodes.label: Design Tokens to Standardize (font, text, space, radius, shadow, motion, soft status, focus)
nodes.norm_label: design tokens to standardize (font, text, space, radius, shadow, motion, soft status, focus)

nodes.label: Business Logic and Architectural Decision Triggers
nodes.norm_label: business logic and architectural decision triggers

nodes.label: Rule: Suggest the Best Approach
nodes.rationale: Act as senior engineering partner: recommend the best approach but let the developer decide on design or business decisions.

nodes.label: Mandatory Pause for Design Improvements
nodes.rationale: Changes to design, architecture, business logic, data flow or observable behavior must not silently replace the user's approach.

nodes.label: Exception: Purely Syntactic Improvements
nodes.rationale: Behavior-preserving syntactic changes can be applied without interrupting the workflow, but must be reported.

nodes.label: Rule: Domain Isolation
nodes.rationale: A change in one domain must not unintentionally break another; every change is evaluated for what depends on it.

nodes.label: Typography Scale --text-* (min 12px)
nodes.rationale: No rendered text below 12px (e2e-verified); 600/400 weight pair keeps product-app calm.

nodes.label: High Priority Diagnosis A1-A7 (small typography, 800x600 fit, brand truncation, inconsistent simulation naming, contrast)
nodes.norm_label: high priority diagnosis a1-a7 (small typography, 800x600 fit, brand truncation, inconsistent simulation naming, contrast)

nodes.label: Medium Priority Diagnosis M1-M11 (card click action, auto-start execution, duplicated components, global CSS)
nodes.norm_label: medium priority diagnosis m1-m11 (card click action, auto-start execution, duplicated components, global css)

nodes.label: Single term 'Simulação' for non-real features
nodes.rationale: Never 'Mock', 'Demonstração' or 'Prévia simulada'; users must know what is real.
